order_book: As of September 30, 2026, the order book stood at approximately INR265 crores, increasing to INR295 crores by the end of October 30, 2026.
We are pleased to further share that we have sec ured an additional order worth INR19 Crores in the medium voltage cable segment, taking the overall order book to over INR310 crores.

The H1 FY27 has been a strong period for Prime Cable marked by significant acceleration in execution, record quarterly revenue, healthy order inflow, and continued progress towards expanding our manufacturing capabilitie
guidance: We are pleased that our normalized revenue performance has already exceeded the growth trajectory contemplated in our earlier guidance of 40 -50% for FY27 with absolute profitability has continued to grow.

For FY27, we expect the new medium voltage line to contribute approximately INR 30-35 crores of normalized revenue during its initial ramp up phase against a peak normalized annual revenue potential of INR150 crores.

focus: Looking ahead, our priorities remain focused on expanding our medium voltage capabilities, fulfilling our growing order pipeline, making working capital more disciplined, and building a strong earnings profile.
